description:
Configure a new Tracked Entity Attribute named 'National PUI' for the 'Person' entity type in the DHIS2 Tracker. 

1. Navigate to Maintenance > Tracker > Tracked Entity Attribute.
2. Create a new attribute named 'National PUI' (Short name: 'Nat PUI').
3. Set Value Type to 'Text' and enable 'Unique'.
4. Configure a Pattern (Regex) to enforce the format: Two Uppercase Letters, a forward slash, and Six Digits (e.g., 'BO/123456').
5. Save the attribute.
6. Navigate to Maintenance > Tracker > Tracked Entity Type.
7. Edit the 'Person' type and assign the 'National PUI' attribute to it.
8. in the assignment settings, enable 'Display in list'.
